text:
maria.engineer: Quick question - rode with two teammates across 3 client sites yesterday. Took an Uber Pool then a separate cab between sites. The Uber receipt shows the total and a toll surcharge but the taxi gave me a cash receipt. How do I itemize tolls vs fare? Also should we split the ride cost across attendees or submit 1 expense with names?

josh.finance: Short answer: submit one expense per payment method. For Uber, use the receipt the app provides (it usually shows tolls as a separate line). For the cash taxi, attach the paper receipt and add a note explaining tolls if not separated.

lara.peopleops: Policy: company pays for travel between client sites during work hours. For shared rides, list attendee names in the expense line (comma separated) and choose "split cost" if using our expense tool. If one person paid, they can submit the full charge and include attendee list for charge allocation.

maria.engineer: The Uber receipt only had "Toll(s) $3.50" as a single line under charges. Does finance need me to break that out numerically in the report?

josh.finance: No need to manually split numeric lines if the receipt includes tolls. We'll match the total to the settled card charge. If you want reimbursement split across people, in the expense tool mark "split among attendees" and the system will allocate amounts (but we reimburse the payer unless others add their share).

tyler.manager: I approve the shared rides. Maria, please include names: Maria, Priya, and Omar. Also confirm whether anyone paid tip in cash for the taxi.

maria.engineer: Taxi tip was cash $2 to the driver. I'll add that note and upload photos of both receipts.

receipts-bot: receipt uploaded: 2176543300_uberpool-nyc-2025-11-10.pdf

josh.finance: Reminder: cash tips should be declared on the expense and will be reimbursed if reasonable. Tolls charged by the vendor are reimbursed as part of the fare. If the taxi toll was charged separately and not on the receipt, include a short attestation: "toll $5 charged on route, included in cash fare".

lara.peopleops: Also note: if the shared ride crosses personal detours (e.g., someone requested a personal stop), we only reimburse the portion that is business-related. Flag any detours in the notes.

maria.engineer: No detours. Uploading taxi receipt now and splitting the Uber in the expense tool. Thanks!"
